formal_statement: ∀ (V : Type) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (F : Set (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.Clause V)) (π : List (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.LinClause V)) (w D : ℕ), (∀ C ∈ F, C.card ≤ w) → 32 * w ≤ D → 32 ≤ D → PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.IsLinRefutation F π → ¬ PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.PCRefutable (PEqualNP.ProofComplexity.cnfSystem F) D → Real.exp (((D : ℝ) ^ 2) / (1024 * (Fintype.card V : ℝ))) ≤ (π.length : ℝ)
plain_statement: A CNF of width w on v variables with no polynomial calculus refutation over F2 of degree D, D at least 32w, has only dag-like Res(+) refutations of at least exp(D^2 / (1024 v)) lines. Cor 1.3 of the unrefereed arXiv:2610.00837, stated there for syntactic weakening; the constant under our semantic weakening is unverified, so this statement may be replaced.
title: Degree to size: a CNF with no F2 polynomial calculus refutation of degree D needs Res(+) refutations of exp(D^2 / (1024 v)) lines
